questions.question: A carpenter designs a round table, but the shopkeeper asks him to reduce its radius by 10%. By what percentage will the table's area be reduced?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Original radius = r

Reduced radius = 0.9r

**Formula Used:**

Area of a circle = π × r²

Percentage change = (Change ÷ Original) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original area = π × r²

⇒ New area = π × (0.9r)²

⇒ New area = π × 0.81r²

⇒ Decrease in area = πr² − 0.81πr²

⇒ Decrease in area = 0.19πr²

⇒ Percentage decrease = (0.19πr² ÷ πr²) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = 19%

**∴ The correct answer is 19%.**

questions.question: In a Bar Council election, two candidates, A and B, contested for the same position. All votes cast were valid, and each member of the Bar Council had to vote. The ratio between the votes cast for A and B was 3:10. If the unsuccessful candidate received 46,860 votes, how many members were there in the Bar Council?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Vote ratio of A : B = 3 : 10

Votes of unsuccessful candidate = 46,860

**Formula Used:**

Total votes = Sum of ratio parts × Value of one part

Value of one part = Actual votes ÷ Ratio part

**Calculation:**

⇒ Unsuccessful candidate has fewer votes

⇒ Smaller ratio part = 3

⇒ Value of one part = 46,860 ÷ 3

⇒ Value of one part = 15,620

⇒ Total ratio parts = 3 + 10

⇒ Total ratio parts = 13

⇒ Total members = 13 × 15,620

⇒ Total members = 203,060

**∴ The correct answer is 203,060.**

questions.question: A cyclist travels a distance of 40 km at a uniform speed. The cyclist wants to cover this distance in 2 hours less than the usual time, so he increases his speed by 10 km/h. At what speed (in km/h) did the cyclist start the journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 40 km

Increase in speed = 10 km/h

Time reduced = 2 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Quadratic equation method

**Calculation:**

⇒ Usual time = 40 ÷ v

⇒ New time = 40 ÷ (v + 10)

⇒ 40 ÷ (v + 10) = 40 ÷ v − 2

⇒ 40v = 40(v + 10) − 2v(v + 10)

⇒ 40v = 40v + 400 − 2v² − 20v

⇒ 0 = 400 − 2v² − 20v

⇒ 2v² + 20v − 400 = 0

⇒ v² + 10v − 200 = 0

⇒ v = {−10 ± √(100 + 800)} ÷ 2

⇒ v = {−10 ± √900} ÷ 2

⇒ v = {−10 ± 30} ÷ 2

⇒ v = 10 (taking positive value)

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km/h.**

questions.question: A company hires two people, A and B, such that A is three times more efficient than B to complete the same task. A alone was able to complete the task in 52 days less than it took B to complete the same task. In how many days will A and B complete the same task together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 3 times as efficient as B

A takes 52 days less than B

**Formula Used:**

Time ∝ 1 ÷ Efficiency

Together time = 1 ÷ (1 ÷ TA + 1 ÷ TB)

**Calculation:**

⇒ If A is 3 times more efficient than B, then TA = TB ÷ 3

⇒ TB − TA = 52

⇒ TB − TB ÷ 3 = 52

⇒ (2TB ÷ 3) = 52

⇒ TB = 78

⇒ TA = 78 ÷ 3

⇒ TA = 26

⇒ Combined work rate = 1 ÷ 26 + 1 ÷ 78

⇒ Combined work rate = 3 ÷ 78 + 1 ÷ 78

⇒ Combined work rate = 4 ÷ 78

⇒ Combined time = 78 ÷ 4

⇒ Combined time = 19(1)/(2)

**∴ The correct answer is 19(1)/(2) days.**

questions.question: A bank makes an offer to its customers saying that if they invest ₹x for one year at an interest rate of 8% per annum (when the interest is compounded half-yearly), they will receive ₹20,280 at the end of the year. If the customer wishes to invest the amount of money X for twice the time at an interest rate of 16% per annum, and the interest is compounded annually, what will be the compound interest (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 1 year = 20,280

Rate = 8% per annum (compounded half-yearly)

Half-yearly rate = 4%

Number of periods = 2

New rate = 16% per annum

New time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + r ÷ 100)ⁿ

Compound Interest = Amount − Principal

**Calculation:**

⇒ 20,280 = x × (1.04)²

⇒ 20,280 = x × 1.0816

⇒ x = 20,280 ÷ 1.0816

⇒ x = 18,750

⇒ New Principal = 18,750

⇒ New Amount = 18,750 × (1.16)²

⇒ (1.16)² = 1.3456

⇒ New Amount = 18,750 × 1.3456

⇒ New Amount = 25,230

⇒ Compound Interest = 25,230 − 18,750

⇒ Compound Interest = 6,480

**∴ The correct answer is 6,480.**

questions.question: ​Let x and y be two positive numbers such that x > y, and the sum of the squares of x and y is 2426 and the square root of x is 7. What is the square of y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x > y

x² + y² = 2426

√x = 7

**Formula Used:**

x = (√x)²

y² = Total − x²

**Calculation:**

⇒ √x = 7

⇒ x = 7²

⇒ x = 49

⇒ x² = 49²

⇒ x² = 2401

⇒ y² = 2426 − 2401

⇒ y² = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

questions.question: A room cooler is initially priced at ₹4,500 and is available at a 15% off-season discount. The shopkeeper offers another discount and sells the cooler for ₹3,519. What is the percentage of the second discount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 4,500

First discount = 15%

Selling price after both discounts = 3,519

**Formula Used:**

Discounted price = Marked price × (1 − discount ÷ 100)

Second discount% = [(Price before second discount − Final price) ÷ Price before second discount] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Price after first discount = 4,500 × (1 − 15 ÷ 100)

⇒ Price after first discount = 4,500 × 0.85

⇒ Price after first discount = 3,825

⇒ Let second discount% = d

⇒ Final price = 3,825 × (1 − d ÷ 100)

⇒ 3,519 = 3,825 × (1 − d ÷ 100)

⇒ 1 − d ÷ 100 = 3,519 ÷ 3,825

⇒ 1 − d ÷ 100 = 0.92

⇒ d ÷ 100 = 1 − 0.92

⇒ d ÷ 100 = 0.08

⇒ d = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**

An electronics shopkeeper purchased three fans at ₹400 each. Due to an off-season sale, he sold one fan at a loss of (1)/(8) of its purchase price. However, he wants to make a profit of 20% on the entire transaction. At what profit percent should he sell the other two fans together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of each fan = 400

Total fans = 3

Loss on one fan = 1 ÷ 8 of CP

Required overall profit = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Total CP = Sum of individual CP

Loss = CP × (loss% ÷ 100)

Required SP = Total CP × (1 + profit% ÷ 100)

Profit% on remaining fans = {(SP − CP) ÷ CP} × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total CP = 3 × 400

⇒ Total CP = 1,200

⇒ Loss on first fan = 400 × (1 ÷ 8)

⇒ Loss = 50

⇒ SP of first fan = 400 − 50

⇒ SP₁ = 350

⇒ Required total SP = 1,200 × 1.20

⇒ Required total SP = 1,440

⇒ SP needed from remaining two fans = 1,440 − 350

⇒ SP needed = 1,090

⇒ CP of two fans = 2 × 400

⇒ CP (two fans) = 800

⇒ Profit on two fans = 1,090 − 800

⇒ Profit = 290

⇒ Profit% = (290 ÷ 800) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 36.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 36.25%.**

questions.question: x is a three-digit number which when divided by 10, 12, 21, 35 and 40 leaves the same remainder 3. What is the minimum value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x leaves remainder 3 when divided by 10, 12, 21, 35, 40

x = 3 (mod divisors)

**Formula Used:**

x = LCM of divisors × k + remainder

LCM = product of highest powers of prime factors

**Calculation:**

⇒ 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ 21 = 3 × 7

⇒ 35 = 5 × 7

⇒ 40 = 2³ × 5

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 8 × 105

⇒ LCM = 840

⇒ x = 840k + 3

⇒ Minimum 3-digit ⇒ k = 1

⇒ x = 840 × 1 + 3

⇒ x = 843

**∴ The correct answer is 843.**
